reviewPolicy.meaning: A focused retest verifies each remediation, but does not convert a CHANGES_REQUESTED review into APPROVED.

phaseOneDisposition.note: Three high red-team findings remain open; this index is neither zero-severe evidence nor release approval.

phaseTwoDisposition.note: Manual cycle control is locally verified; production integrations and owner-controlled release gates remain open.

findings: A downstream gate could still be owner-overridden while an upstream prerequisite was failed.

remediation.summary: Reject downstream overrides until prerequisite gates are authoritative.

findings: Gas evidence did not enforce the exact production-contract set and section bounds.
The gas run did not require the exact six-test completion summary.
Executable identity was not fully bound to the trusted toolchain and frozen pins.
Candidate verification did not fully bind the trusted manifest digest, unique paths, and exact runner set.
Dependency cleanliness did not include untracked files.
Report output needed repository-bound, non-symlink, atomic writes.

remediation.summary: Closed all six review findings in the verifier, report, documentation, and focused regressions.
remediation.verification: 9/9 focused tests passed; real offline reproducibility run passed

reviews.scopeLimit: Only RT-R55-03 was closed; RT-R55-02, RT-R55-05, and RT-R55-06 remain open high findings.

findings: The release verifier needed to recompute the exact canonical artifact digest and set.
Static inputs, source-commit manifest, and local gas evidence needed exact binding.
Forge scratch cleanup needed to survive body and post-check failures outside a hostile TMPDIR.
Tool executables needed to be absolute regular non-symlink files.

remediation.summary: Closed all four verifier findings and refreshed the exact candidate shape.
remediation.verification: 8/8 focused release tests passed; 1/1 isolated integration smoke passed

findings: The harness did not exercise the productive PayoutCommitment path.
The release-plan source guard could miss fallback or receive entry points and comment-based bypasses.
The release verifier did not bind the local reproducibility report.
Runtime validation did not bind expected code hashes.
The verifier did not require positive invariant run and call counts.

remediation.summary: Closed all five findings in the harness, release-plan guard, reproducibility binding, runtime checks, and invariant-output parser.
remediation.verification: 10/10 focused Node tests passed; 8/8 Forge tests passed; all 7 invariants reported 256 runs and 128000 calls; integrated local release verification passed with 51 files and 5 checks
